note: Andhra Pradesh State Board (AP SCERT / Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh). AP and Telangana split from a common state board in 2014 and have since revised their textbooks independently; this catalog is built for AP specifically, not copied from Telangana. SOURCES: the official curriculum authority apscert.gov.in was unreachable (DNS failure) throughout research, and bse.ap.gov.in hosts only exam-administration content, so every chapter list here comes from secondary sources (marked 'fetched-secondary' per subject) — chiefly apboardsolutions.com/.in, byjus.com, netexplanations.com, selfstudys.com, careers360 and aakash. The one official government source reached, cse.ap.gov.in (Commissioner of School Education, AP), confirmed the SUBJECT STRUCTURE used below though not chapter titles. SUBJECT MAPPING: AP runs a single combined 'Science' textbook for Class 6 and Class 7 (id 'science'), then splits it from Class 8 into two separate subjects/books — 'Physical Science' (Physics + Chemistry, id 'physical_science') and 'Biology' (Biological Science, id 'biological_science'). Social Studies is one combined subject (id 'social') across all grades, spanning History, Geography, Civics/Political Science and Economics (published as separate discipline booklets under one subject for Classes 8-10). COMPUTER SCIENCE is intentionally OMITTED: research found no distinct, currently-examined AP SCERT Computer Science/IT textbook or syllabus for any of Classes 6-10 (unlike Telangana, which does publish one); AP treats ICT as cross-curricular literacy rather than a standalone graded subject, so no chapter list was fabricated for it. SYLLABUS VERSION CAVEATS: AP reformed its state syllabus around 2020 toward NCERT/SCF alignment, and secondary sources circulate both 'old' and 'new' chapter lists for some grades. Class 10 Mathematics uses the AP-distinctive sequence (including Sets, Similar Triangles, and Tangents and Secants to a Circle); a fully NCERT-mirrored alternative also circulates. Class 7 and Class 9 Social Studies use the NCERT-aligned 'new syllabus' presented as current; older AP-specific lists exist. Class 6 Science chapter 6 ('Habitat') is a model-knowledge best-guess — the secondary source could not confirm that single title. Class 6-9 Science chapter lists rest largely on single secondary sources (moderate confidence); Class 10 Biology is triple-cross-verified (high confidence).
